answer: Anchor each agent to a home hub, then once a month assign it to another hub within 50 km. The agent has to show up in person, scan a rotating QR code, and get signatures from two established agents present that day. Miss the check-in and payouts freeze for 30 days. A farmer running 100 fake agents cannot let them wander from screen to screen. Every identity needs a paid stand-in at $80 to $150 per visit, or $8,000 to $15,000 a month before travel, and the same face under different names stands out, like one dune on flat ground, and gets removed.
